platforms.title: AFlow
platforms.subtitle: Design with AI, without losing the design.
platforms.description: A node-based studio where architects create, govern, and trace design decisions on a single canvas. Connect text, image, 3D, and reasoning nodes into a process that remembers your intent, records who made what, and lets you lock the parts that define a scheme. Exports to IFC/BIM.

platforms.title: Data Hard Hats
platforms.subtitle: AEC Unlocked — free, government-funded data & AI training.
platforms.description: A Scottish Government-funded programme helping AEC SMEs unlock the value in their data and build confidence with AI. Four regional cohorts move through three hands-on sessions, backed by one-to-one consultancy and a personalised Data Readiness Report. No tech background required.
